market.question: Will the highest temperature in Tokyo be 26°C on May 8?

assessment.reasoning: Tokyo Haneda forecast for May 8 is high 74°F (~23°C). Question asks if highest resolves in 26°C bucket. Forecast is 3°C below threshold. Probability of overshooting forecast by 3°C is low.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Foehn effect or unusual warm advection could push highs higher.
